title: Categorize contracts + handlers: queue with bundles, run start/status, accept batch, skip, threshold settings
description: shared/src/contracts/categorize/: categorize_queue_list (uncategorized transactions with suggestions, grouped into bundles = same payee + same top suggestion, paged; threshold applied at read time), categorize_run_start, categorize_run_status, categorize_accept (batch of {transaction_id, category_id}; goes through the existing transaction update path), categorize_skip, categorize_settings_get/set (per-budget threshold). Nothing is ever applied without an explicit accept. Queue must work with no AI key (rows with no suggestions). Plan, decisions and owner answers: handoff.md at the repo root. Mock: tk show budget-seoa (evidence ev-c96ced overview, PNGs). Follow AGENTS.md (contracts, migrations additive only + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, i18n, ports, test DB rules).
acceptance_criteria: Samples in access.test.ts and catalog-outputs.test.ts; ids re-scoped by budget_id; test:api green.
